dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple well-defined 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are clustered along the upper dorsal arch. These structures possess thin, high-intensity light-colored borders that exhibit a sharp gradient transition into uniform dark-intensity cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the anterior neck and head region. A lower density of larger, asymmetrical high-intensity blobs is scattered across the mid-lateral and posterior surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli at the apex of the dorsal arch form an obtuse triangle. A secondary set of four high-intensity blobs forms a near-linear arrangement along the mid-lateral posterior axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of jagged, linear markings with high contrast and visible relief are present on the anterior lateral shoulder area, distinct from the surrounding pelt pattern.
